lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs3LiF6 crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cs centers in two environments: octahedral coordination by six F neighbors and a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 F neighbors, while Li centers are octahedrally coordinated by six F neighbors. The same analysis finds corner-sharing between Cs octahedra and Li octahedra, and face-sharing between Cs 12-vertex polyhedra and Li octahedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
